notes: A real moment of their work (stage, job site, classroom). Before it goes on the poster, record who owns it and where their permission is kept. A photo found on a public post is not permission: use the client's own photos, or get the owner's written OK. Put the exact file you downloaded in source_file_url and the original file's pixel width in native_px_w. Set camera_original yes only for a file straight from the camera; the script confirms it from the camera data. Never enlarge a small file and call it print quality.
A clear head-and-shoulders photo of the subject, ideally from their own team or About page (owner: their company) or supplied by their team.

A map or diagram you drew from public data. Name the data source in notes. Vector (SVG) prints sharp at any size. A map is optional: the kit has no map tool. Draw one as SVG (for example with d3-geo and us-atlas) or mark this row omit.
Team photos the company owns (its own team page) or supplied by the team. Mark the row omit if there is no team zone.
